source.title: Jelly Squash Free Sprites
source.status: Downloaded and inspected; four adapted gel surfaces and an unmodified contact shadow integrated
source.animations: None included; static bodies and separate faces. Runtime deformation is authored separately.

status: Derived from the integrated acquired artwork; material maps for runtime shader sampling
animation: No baked animation. Runtime distance-field blending deforms the acquired painted surfaces.

processing.distance: Exact two-pass squared Euclidean lower envelope, followed by square root; distances between pixel centers
processing.sign: Negative inside the original alpha >= 128 silhouette; positive outside
processing.alpha: round(255 * clamp(0.5 + signed_distance_pixels / 128, 0, 1)); round uses nearest integer with ties to even
processing.rgb: Original RGB retained inside the silhouette; exterior RGB copied from the nearest interior pixel
processing.tie_break: Equal-distance nearest pixels prefer smaller y, then smaller x
processing.runtime_decode: signed_distance_pixels = (sample.a - 0.5) * 128; alpha is data and must not be used as display opacity
processing.source_preservation: The original gel PNGs are read-only inputs and are not modified
processing.godot_import: Lossless; no mipmaps, alpha border repair or premultiplication. Alpha is distance data, including zero inside the painted body.
